capabilities.economic_reason: Return generation is not wealth compounding: a 1x->30x->1x path has a realised log growth of zero and every other metric this desk keeps calls it a success
capabilities.source_spec: LEWIS FUSION v3 §4/§5/§69; BEAT-LEWIS 'compounding not gambling'
capabilities.economic_mechanism: The geometric penalty for overbetting is unbounded while the underbetting cost is bounded by forgone growth, so an edge estimate sized as a known constant eventually returns the stack. Pricing posterior width and reserve option value against the MARGINAL unit is what makes aggression safe rather than what makes it cautious.
capabilities.information_value: Turns 'are we keeping it' from unmeasured into GAIN_RETENTION_RATIO / ROUND_TRIP_RATIO / MAXIMUM_GIVEBACK. Currently UNMEASURED because no NAV path exists.
capabilities.runtime_cost: negligible; pure arithmetic over a NAV vector
capabilities.existing_equivalent: libs/research/profit_retention.py computes MFE/MAE and capture ratio per RETURN SERIES; this operates on the NAV path with external flows removed and prices the marginal exposure decision. No overlap in inputs or outputs.
capabilities.expected_delta_elogw: Large and defensive: it does not add return, it prevents the failure mode that sets accumulated return to zero.
capabilities.next_action: Produce data/nav_path.json from the live book once a first fill exists; until then every metric here correctly reports UNMEASURED.

capabilities.title: F3 STATE_CONDITIONAL_MECHANISM validation branch
capabilities.economic_reason: gate_power measured F3 keeping only ~50% of planted CONDITIONAL edges at EVERY effect size -- a structural coin flip, not an underpowered test
capabilities.source_spec: LEWIS FUSION v3 §16 (P0); supersedes CONDITIONAL_BRANCH (completion mandate §5) and STATE_CONDITIONAL_MECHANISM (regime extension §4) -- three ledger rows for one capability, merged rather than left to look like three pieces of unfinished work
capabilities.economic_mechanism: A both-arms walk-forward rule tests NOISE in the arm where a conditional mechanism is inactive, and noise is positive by chance ~50% of the time regardless of effect size. Conditional alpha is therefore discarded at a rate no amount of real edge can overcome. The recovered population is real edge the desk currently kills.
capabilities.information_value: Makes the ~50% ceiling actionable instead of merely known. POST_HOC_RESCUE refusal also closes the desk's most attractive defect: finding a profitable slice after a failure and calling it a regime.
capabilities.existing_equivalent: libs/validation/gate_power.py MEASURES the ceiling; this is the separate harder path that recovers from it. Global F3 in scripts/run_full_sweep.py is untouched.
capabilities.measured_value: F3 retention: STABLE 100% vs CONDITIONAL 50% at planted effect 0.10 (gate_power controls)
capabilities.expected_delta_elogw: Direct: recovers a class of survivors the current gate discards at a rate independent of how strong they are.
capabilities.next_action: Emit data/state_conditional_candidates.json from run_full_sweep.py for every cell whose in/out-of-regime split is materially asymmetric, preregistered BEFORE the untouched arm is opened.

capabilities.title: Payoff-aware model selection (E[log W], never accuracy)
capabilities.economic_reason: An 89%-accurate model that wins 1bp and loses 12bp is the best model on any accuracy leaderboard and loses 5.4bp per trade
capabilities.economic_mechanism: AUC, accuracy and hit rate are invariant to payoff size, which is the quantity that decides wealth. Ranking on annualised expected log growth and breaking ties on calibration is what makes a probability output SIZABLE rather than merely correct.
capabilities.information_value: Exposes hit-rate inversions in words, so a correct ranking is not overridden by whoever reads the accuracy column.
capabilities.existing_equivalent: libs/validation/track_record.py scores realised records; this ranks CANDIDATE models by forward economics before one is chosen.
capabilities.expected_delta_elogw: Direct: changes which model gets capital.
capabilities.next_action: Emit data/model_records.json from the panel/LLM scoring path and from each survivor's forward record.

capabilities.economic_mechanism: No economic mechanism of its own -- it is a measurement discipline. Its value is preventing two specific errors: chasing a TARGET that was never a result, and believing a lead computed from a gross/unrealised/undisclosed-flow figure against our net realised one.
capabilities.information_value: Makes 'are we winning' answerable or explicitly unanswerable. An unreportable lead is a fact about the evidence, and it is the honest answer today.

capabilities.title: Effective sample size / window-overlap correction
capabilities.economic_reason: t scales as sqrt(n); a tenfold inflated row count is a threefold inflated t-statistic applied silently to every candidate the sweep has ever produced
capabilities.source_spec: LEWIS FUSION v3 §15 (P0); v4 P0 'effective sample/overlap correction'
capabilities.economic_mechanism: A 30-day feature computed daily shares 29 of its 30 days with yesterday's value. Six dependence sources compound -- overlap, autocorrelation, shared events, regime concentration, common factor, cross-venue -- and a sample can suffer all six at once. Deflating the COUNT rather than subsampling keeps the data and its power.
capabilities.information_value: Turns every `n` on this desk from a raw row count into a defensible one. Unmeasured deflators return 1.0 and are reported as INERT, so a clean number cannot be read as six passed checks.
capabilities.existing_equivalent: libs/research/evidence_clock.py deflates FORWARD evidence for a promotion decision; libs/validation/cpcv.py CONSTRUCTS purged splits. Neither answers how many independent observations a sample already in hand contains.
capabilities.expected_delta_elogw: Defensive and large: it removes false discoveries that would otherwise be sized with real capital.
capabilities.next_action: Emit data/sample_geometry.json from run_full_sweep.py per cell -- window length, step, autocorrelation, distinct events and regimes are all available at evaluation time and none is currently recorded.

capabilities.economic_reason: A spectacular public return is either a mechanism we lack or an artefact of leverage, beta, concentration or luck -- both answers are valuable and cheap to separate
capabilities.source_spec: POST-BASELINE DELTA Part VII Role B, IX, X, XI, XXIV
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Only ALPHA, CARRY and CONVEXITY transfer. Beta and leverage are available to anyone with an account; concentration is a sizing decision; luck is luck. A claim with no described mechanism has a transferable share of zero by construction, however large.
capabilities.information_value: Priority = P(real) x P(transferable) x log-magnitude x novelty x capacity x horizon credibility. Magnitude enters through a LOG so a claimed 1000% cannot outrank a verified 50% by twenty times -- which is exactly the error the ledger exists to prevent.
capabilities.existing_equivalent: libs/research/external_benchmark.py compares OUR curve to a claim; this decomposes the claim itself into what could be copied and what could not. Different question, complementary.
capabilities.expected_delta_elogw: Indirect: it converts competitors into free seed capital for the search process without importing their claims as evidence.

capabilities.title: Maximum Economic Frontier: shadow-priced surplus, bundles and frontier regret
capabilities.economic_reason: The existing queue ranks by distance-from-ceiling, which puts a 0% research module above deploying a validated survivor -- correct for a ratchet and wrong for an allocator
capabilities.source_spec: MAXIMUM ECONOMIC FRONTIER LAW + the six surgical fixes (shadow prices, distributions, feasibility filter, bundles, regret, anti-Goodhart)
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Every scarce resource carries a shadow price, so opportunity cost enters ONCE rather than twice. Feasibility is a filter applied before optimisation, so no estimate however optimistic can outbid a survival constraint. Bundles are evaluated against greedy singles, so a set that only pays together is not lost to a greedy pick.
capabilities.information_value: FRONTIER_REGRET -- the gap between the best feasible set KNOWN at the time and what was actually done -- lets the desk learn not merely that a trade was bad but that the whole day's resources went to the wrong place.
capabilities.existing_equivalent: scripts/run_max_push.py is the RATCHET and is deliberately kept: it never reports done and escalates when everything is green. The frontier is the ALLOCATOR. Replacing one with the other would lose a control the desk relies on, so both are published.
capabilities.measured_value: surpluses are DERIVED from declared leverage weights via one conversion constant; the ordering is informative, the magnitudes are not yet and no sizing decision may cite them
capabilities.expected_delta_elogw: High: it is the only ranking that can put deploying a survivor above building another module.
capabilities.next_action: Feed measured posterior distributions from the wealth report and live ladder so the magnitudes stop being derived. Shadow prices for compute, engineering time and llm_tokens are UNMEASURED and those resources currently look free.

capabilities.title: Anti-regression ratchet and capability-loss ledger
capabilities.economic_reason: A change that is better along the axis its author was watching and worse along one they were not reads as an upgrade in the commit message and is undetectable afterwards
capabilities.source_spec: POST-BASELINE DELTA Part I, XXVIII, XXIX, XXX, XLII
capabilities.economic_mechanism: No market mechanism. Its value is preventing silent capability loss: shorter prompts that cost two source languages, a simpler architecture that cost an independent reviewer, a faster pipeline that stopped running a validator. Each reads as progress and none is measurable afterwards unless the incumbent was captured first.
capabilities.information_value: Cost savings enter as SAVINGS and never as reasons that stand alone. The converse is equally enforced -- complexity that earns more than it costs is an UPGRADE and this module has no bias toward smaller, so it cannot be cited against expansion.
capabilities.existing_equivalent: docs/research/COVERAGE_RATCHET.json ratchets COVERAGE only. libs/doctrine/ratchet.py ratchets declared metrics. Neither captures capability BREADTH -- source languages, reviewer count, hypothesis breadth -- which is exactly what a simplification silently removes.
capabilities.measured_value: NO-INPUT: data/capability_snapshots.json absent, so every change on this desk is currently an unverified upgrade claim
capabilities.expected_delta_elogw: Defensive: it protects the accumulated research breadth that every other capability sits on.
capabilities.next_action: Emit data/capability_snapshots.json before/after each material subsystem change. Until then the organ correctly reports NO-INPUT rather than a clean board.

capabilities.title: Capital recycling: keep / reduce / harvest / rotate / redeploy
capabilities.economic_reason: The difference between a large gain and a kept one is what happened next; done by fixed rule it is a coin flip with extra steps
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Every action is an E[log W] comparison and ties resolve to KEEP because each alternative pays a round trip. No entry price or unrealised gain is a field on the dataclass, so a large winner cannot acquire ownership privilege even by accident.
capabilities.information_value: CAPITAL_RECYCLING_ALPHA -- realised log growth minus holding the same exposure throughout. It can be NEGATIVE, and no other metric on the recycling path would ever say so.
capabilities.existing_equivalent: libs/portfolio/capital_competition.py allocates across candidates. This decides what to do with a position already held, which that module does not ask.
capabilities.measured_value: UNMEASURED -- data/positions.json absent; the desk holds nothing
capabilities.expected_delta_elogw: High and defensive: the mechanism that turns a large gain into a kept one.
capabilities.next_action: Emit data/positions.json with forward edge, posterior width and regime hazard per position once a live book exists.

capabilities.title: Strategy pool: exposure efficiency, reshuffled sizing, bench swaps
capabilities.economic_reason: Two strategies at +20%/yr are not the same strategy if one is flat 90% of the year, and sizing off a backtest drawdown is sizing off the luckiest trade ordering
capabilities.source_spec: POST-BASELINE DELTA Part IV.3/IV.6; extracted from the Chart Fanatics/Naoufel corpus 2026-08-08
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Return per unit of TIME IN MARKET: uncommitted capital funds other strategies and is absent from the windows in which a gap or cascade can reach it. Sizing and retirement both key off the reshuffled drawdown distribution, never the observed ordering or a fixed multiple of it.
capabilities.information_value: Turns the retirement trigger from an invented constant (the source's '1.5x backtest DD') into the strategy's own reshuffled tail -- a multiplier fires early on a fat tail and late on a tight one because it knows nothing about the shape.
capabilities.existing_equivalent: libs/discovery/monte_carlo_survival.py computes the reshuffled distribution and was ALREADY BUILT; nothing used it as a sizing or retirement input. libs/research/alpha_state.py has lifecycle rungs but no standing bench.
capabilities.measured_value: UNMEASURED -- data/strategy_pool.json absent; there is no bench, so a degrading strategy can only be switched off
capabilities.expected_delta_elogw: Direct: the difference between replacing a decayed strategy and losing its capital.
capabilities.next_action: Populate data/strategy_pool.json from the shadow slots; every field except market_exposure_fraction is already computed somewhere on the box.

capabilities.title: Crowding decay hazard from book evidence
capabilities.economic_reason: By the time returns confirm an edge is crowded the money is gone; decay is indistinguishable from bad luck until the sample is large enough to be sure
capabilities.source_spec: LEWIS FUSION v4 §57; POST-BASELINE DELTA Part VI.15
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Crowding leaves fingerprints on the book before it reaches the P&L: spread, basis and funding compress; queues lengthen; fills deteriorate; impact rises. All six are measured against the strategy's OWN baseline, because an absolute spread means nothing across instruments.
capabilities.information_value: The realised edge ratio is a CHECK on the hazard and never an input -- a hazard that reads the P&L is a lagging indicator wearing a leading indicator's name. Public diffusion is computed, reported and EXCLUDED, because 'publication destroys edge' is widely believed and unmeasured here.
capabilities.existing_equivalent: libs/alpha_factory/crowding_intelligence.py steers RESEARCH away from crowded concepts -- a question about where to look. This asks whether a strategy already running is being competed away.
capabilities.expected_delta_elogw: Direct: predicting decay before P&L confirms it is alpha retention.
capabilities.next_action: Emit data/crowding_states.json from the execution tape and the funding/basis recorders, all of which already run.

capabilities.title: Participant phenotype engine and crowd directionality
capabilities.economic_reason: 'Retail' is a sum over populations that behave oppositely; aggregating them cancels the informative components and produces the noise most flow studies report
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Eight behavioural cohorts defined by conduct, never by identity. The relation to price is estimated per phenotype PER STATE, so follow-retail and fade-retail are both refused as fixed signs and NEUTRAL is a common honest answer.
capabilities.information_value: Composition shift is measured FIRST: an aggregate can move because the same people changed behaviour or because different people arrived, and those carry opposite implications. directionality() refuses a verdict when composition moved materially.
capabilities.existing_equivalent: libs/data/wallet_graph.py and onchain_flows.py supply flow primitives. Neither models cohorts or separates behaviour change from population change.
capabilities.expected_delta_elogw: Moderate and gated on data the desk does not yet have.
capabilities.next_action: Requires a cohort-resolved flow source. Wallet-level on-chain data can support several phenotypes; broker-cohort data cannot be obtained lawfully here.

capabilities.title: Mechanism ontology and constrained alpha grammar
capabilities.economic_reason: A million random formulas and a million real questions are the same size and only one survives multiplicity correction
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Every mechanism carries a contract -- which observables MEASURE it, which transforms mean anything, which horizons its economics could survive, what would falsify it. A 90-day order-flow candidate is refused before it costs anything, because OFI measures who is pressing the book now.
capabilities.information_value: MEASURED: 5 mechanisms generate 1,549 coherent candidates from 9,282 combinations -- 83% pruned before any compute. The pruned part is not a random sample: it is the part with no economic story, which is where false positives come from fastest. Every candidate carries its sibling count, so no winner can be detached from its selection path.
capabilities.existing_equivalent: libs/research/mechanism_fingerprint.py answers whether two ideas are the SAME idea for dedupe. This decides which ideas may be CONSTRUCTED at all.
capabilities.measured_value: 83% prune rate over the shipped 5-mechanism ontology; 1,549 coherent candidates enumerated
capabilities.expected_delta_elogw: High: the difference between a hypothesis factory and a formula generator.
capabilities.next_action: Register mechanisms from the external-intelligence seats. The ontology is deliberately small -- it holds only mechanisms this desk can already measure from data it already has.
